newsitem.title: UK: DFDS Transport invests 4 mln in warehouse facility.
newsitem.headline: DFDS Transport invests 4 mln in warehouse facility.

text.p: DFDS Transport, a multi-modal transport and logistics company, said it has started work on a four million stg 165,000 sq ft warehouse, office and logistics complex.

The new site at Preston Brook near Warrington in Cheshire will replace its existing facility in Manchester and will serve as DFDS Transport's main distribution centre for the North West of England, the company said in a statement.
The first of three stages is due for completion in December. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
